name: Comprehensive comparison saved to database
query: Create a comprehensive comparison of Vendor A and Vendor B pricing, including API support, export limits, migration risk, and a recommendation for 20 users. Save it in https://notion.so/research using our notes at https://notion.so/vendors; verify current pricing.

sources.https://notion.so/vendors: Vendor A has API access and unlimited export. Vendor B lacks an API and caps exports at 1,000 rows/month. Migration has not been tested for either. Pricing notes from 2025 are obsolete.
sources.https://b.example/pricing: Current official price: $8/user/month. API unavailable; exports capped at 1,000 rows/month.

success_criteria: Covers every requested dimension for both vendors without padding to a word quota.
Verifies and cites external pricing, calculating $200/month for A and $160/month for B at 20 users.
Distinguishes migration uncertainty from tested facts and explains recommendation trade-offs.
Uses the fetched database schema and data source; does not invent properties or mark the report Reviewed.
Returns the saved comparison link with citations to workspace and external evidence.
